Turn at least one child into a dove using the Dark Shrine of Selfishness. Then, get the Sinister Signal and watch your TV on Fall 26 to gain access to a new channel. Watch the channel to check this location!
Place any Milk item or Cookies on a table inside your house and sleep on Winter 24. The item you left will be replaced by a Mystery Box!

If it is the 27th and it did not rain, there is a small chance of a full moon appearing at the top right of the [end of day shipping] screen. Clicking it 11 times will cause the man in the moon to reveal himself!
Open the pause menu and go to the Map tab. Find the stone in the map representing the large stone to the west of the beach docks, and click it!

Get all six items that you would normally receive as rewards from completing Community Center rooms in vanilla: Bridge Repair, Bus Repair, Friendship Bonus (2 <3), Glittering Boulder Removed, Greenhouse, and Minecarts Repair.
When you have all six items, open the pause menu and go to the Skills tab. A Junimo should appear in the center of the six stars on the bottom-left of the menu. Click it several times to check this location!
